newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.

text.p: Tight dollar selling by state-owned banks kept the Bangladesh taka under strain in interbank trading on Tuesday, dealers said.
Taka finished weaker at 44.2100/2150 to the dollar against a previous close at 44.2050/2100.
"Some foreign banks quoted prices as high as 44.2400 per dollar at one stage because of the shortfall (in dollar) though they couldn't make deals at that level," said ond dealer.
"Many banks either opted to wait till Wednesday or went to the central bank for dollar," he added.
The call money was traded at 7.0 to 7.5 percent against the previous day's 7.5-8.0 percent.
